local _stage2AtkTypes = {ATK_TYPE.atk,ATK_TYPE.fart,ATK_TYPE.atk,ATK_TYPE.dash}

function changeToIceBody()
	local startSize = Vector3.one * 0.1
	for _,basePart:BasePart in ipairs(_madParts) do
		local targetSize = basePart.Size
		basePart.Size = startSize
		basePart.Transparency = 0

		local hightlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
		hightlight.FillTransparency = 1
		hightlight.Parent = basePart
		game.Debris:AddItem(hightlight,5)

		game.TweenService:Create(basePart,TweenInfo.new(3),{
			Size = targetSize
		}):Play()
	end
	
	local change = function(partName:string)
		local basePart:MeshPart = bull:FindFirstChild(partName)
		if basePart then
			local SurfaceAppearance = basePart:FindFirstChild("SurfaceAppearance")
			if SurfaceAppearance then
				SurfaceAppearance:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end
	change("LeftHand")
	change("LeftLowerArm")
	change("RightHand")
	change("RightLowerArm")
end

-- 刷新目标
function updateTarget()
	-- 1.目标是否存活
	-- 2.目标是否在战场
	if v_Sleep.Value then return end
	
	v_targetPlayer.Value = nil
	local characters = game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.OnBullBattleGround)
	while #characters > 0 do
		local character = table.remove(characters,math.random(1,#characters))
		if GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(character) then
			v_targetPlayer.Value = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
			break
		end
	end	
end

function triggerAttack(atkType:number?)
	--if atkType == ATK_TYPE.special then
	--	atkType = ATK_TYPE.fart
	--	if v_Mad.Value then
	--		-- 愤怒状态
	--		if math.random(1,2) == 1 then
	--			atkType = ATK_TYPE.dash -- 冲撞
	--		end
	--	else
	--		if math.random(1,2) == 1 then
	--			atkType = ATK_TYPE.snowball -- 扔雪球
	--		end
	--	end
	--end	
	
	if atkType == ATK_TYPE.atk then
		--print("普攻")
		v_Busy.Value = true
		local t = 1
		attackTrack:Play()
		humanoidRootPart.attackbefore:Play()
		task.wait(t)
		bull.AttackS2C:FireAllClients(atkType,15,t)
		task.wait(t)
		bull.AttackS2C:FireAllClients(atkType,15,t)
		task.wait(t+1)
	elseif atkType == ATK_TYPE.snowball then
		--print("雪球")
		v_Busy.Value = true
		humanoidRootPart.skillbefore:Play()
		if GameHelper:isAlive(v_targetPlayer.Value) then
			local character:Model = v_targetPlayer.Value.Character
			bull.AttackS2C:FireAllClients(atkType,character)
			snowballTrack:Play()
			task.wait(4)
		end
	elseif atkType == ATK_TYPE.fart then
		--print("放屁")
		v_Busy.Value = true
		fartTrack:Play()
		--humanoidRootPart.skillbefore:Play()

		ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(bull,EnemyValue.walkSpeed,"想放屁",0)
		task.wait(1)
		humanoidRootPart.fart:Play()
		
		local LowerTorso = bull.LowerTorso
		local fart = workspace.Prefabs.Others:FindFirstChild("屁"):Clone()
		fart.CFrame = CFrame.new(LowerTorso.Position)
		fart.Parent = workspace
		
		task.wait(1)
		fartTrack:Stop()
	elseif atkType == ATK_TYPE.dash then
		--print("冲刺")
		local preTime = 2
		local duration = 1.5
		v_Busy.Value = true
		humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero)
		
		-- 冲刺预备
		humanoidRootPart.skillbefore:Play()
		dashbeforeTrack:Play()
		dashStartPar.Enabled = true
		task.wait(preTime)
		dashbeforeTrack:Stop()
		dashStartPar.Enabled = false
		
		-- 开始冲刺
		DashTrail.Enabled = true
		DashPar.Enabled = true
		dashTrack:Play()
		bull.AttackS2C:FireAllClients(atkType,duration)
		
		-- 计算方向
		if GameHelper:isAlive(v_targetPlayer.Value) then
			local character:Model = v_targetPlayer.Value.Character
			local lastDir:Vector3 = ((character:GetPivot().Position - bull:GetPivot().Position) * CommonEnum.XZ).Unit
			humanoid:Move(lastDir)
			ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(bull,NpcAttributeValue.walkSpeed,"冲撞",100)
		end
		task.wait(duration)
		-- 停止冲刺动画
		DashTrail.Enabled = false
		DashPar.Enabled = false
		dashTrack:Stop()
		
		-- 停止移动
		humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero)
		ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(bull,NpcAttributeValue.walkSpeed,"冲撞",0)
		
		-- 晕
		dashafterTrack:Play()
		giddyPar.Enabled = true
		humanoidRootPart.dizzy:Play()
		humanoidRootPart.strike:Play()
		--GameHelper:KickAss(bull,humanoidRootPart.Position)
		task.wait(3)
		dashafterTrack:Stop()
		giddyPar.Enabled = false
		humanoidRootPart.dizzy:Stop()
	end

	local curAtkMode = _stage1AtkTypes
	if v_Mad.Value then
		curAtkMode = _stage2AtkTypes 
	end
	_atkTypeIndex += 1
	if _atkTypeIndex > #curAtkMode then
		_atkTypeIndex = 1
	end
	
	-- 随机下次攻击类型
	local newAtkType = curAtkMode[_atkTypeIndex]
	if newAtkType == ATK_TYPE.special then
		newAtkType = ATK_TYPE.fart
		if v_Mad.Value then
			-- 愤怒状态
			if math.random(1,2) == 1 then
				newAtkType = ATK_TYPE.dash -- 冲撞
			end
		else
			if math.random(1,2) == 1 then
				newAtkType = ATK_TYPE.snowball -- 扔雪球
			end
		end
	end	
	
	if newAtkType == ATK_TYPE.fart then
		-- 移速加成
		ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(bull,EnemyValue.walkSpeed,"想放屁",10)
		-- 想放屁的音效
		humanoidRootPart.fartbefore:Play()
	end
	_curAtkType = newAtkType
	
	if not GameHelper:isAlive(v_targetPlayer.Value) then
		updateTarget()
	end
	
	v_Busy.Value = false
end

humanoid.Running:Connect(function(speed: number) 
	if bull.PrimaryPart.Anchored then return end
	--if v_Busy.Value then return end

	if speed > 1 then
		if not walkTrack.IsPlaying then walkTrack:Play() end
		if not stepSound.IsPlaying then stepSound:Play() end
		if idleTrack.IsPlaying then idleTrack:Stop() end
	else
		if walkTrack.IsPlaying then walkTrack:Stop() end
		if stepSound.IsPlaying then stepSound:Stop() end
		if not idleTrack.IsPlaying then idleTrack:Play() end
	end
end)

		GameHelper:PlayerAddFreezeMeter(player,10)
		GameHelper:PlayerTakeDamage(player,damage,bull)

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function(t:number,dt:number)
	if bull.PrimaryPart.Anchored then return end
	if v_Sleep.Value then return end

	if workspace.DistributedGameTime >= nextMoveTime then
		nextMoveTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime + 0.1
		if GameHelper:isAlive(v_targetPlayer.Value) then
			if not v_Busy.Value then
				local character:Model = v_targetPlayer.Value.Character
				local bullPos = bull:GetPivot().Position
				local targetPos = character:GetPivot().Position
				local offset = (targetPos - bullPos) * CommonEnum.XZ
				local distance = offset.Magnitude
				
				if _curAtkType == ATK_TYPE.atk then
					if distance <= 10 then
						humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero)
						task.spawn(function()
							-- 近战攻击
							triggerAttack(_curAtkType)
						end) 
					else
						humanoid:Move(offset.Unit)
					end
				elseif _curAtkType == ATK_TYPE.snowball then
					if distance <= 50 then
						humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero)
						task.spawn(function()
							-- 雪球攻击
							triggerAttack(_curAtkType)
						end) 
					else
						humanoid:Move(offset.Unit)
					end	
				elseif _curAtkType == ATK_TYPE.dash then
					if distance <= 50 then
						--humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero)
						task.spawn(function()
							-- 冲撞攻击
							triggerAttack(_curAtkType)
						end) 
					else
						humanoid:Move(offset.Unit)
					end	
				elseif _curAtkType == ATK_TYPE.fart then
					if distance <= 10 then
						humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero)
						task.spawn(function()
							-- 放屁
							triggerAttack(_curAtkType)
						end) 
					else
						humanoid:Move(offset.Unit)
					end
				end
			end
		else
			--humanoid:MoveTo(spawnPosition)
		end	
	end
end)

local baseMoveSpeed = horse.Values.WalkSpeed.Value
local baseRunSpeed = horse.Values.RunSpeed.Value
local baseJumpPower = humanoid.JumpPower
local bonusConnections = {}

math.randomseed(tick())
local shitCD = math.random(300,600)
CommonFunc:SetCollisionGroup(horse,"Horse")

local function disconnectBonusConnections()
	for _, connection in ipairs(bonusConnections) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(bonusConnections)
end

local function getRidingPlayer()
	if not occupant then return end
	return game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(occupant.Parent)
end

local function getPlayerAttributeBonus(player:Player, valueObject:ValueBase)
	if not player or not valueObject then return 0 end
	local value = ValueHelper:FindValue(player, valueObject)
	return value and value.Value or 0
end

local function updateHorseMovementStats()
	local player = getRidingPlayer()
	local speedBonus = getPlayerAttributeBonus(player, PlayerAttributeValue.horseSpeedBonus)
	local jumpPowerBonus = getPlayerAttributeBonus(player, PlayerAttributeValue.horseJumpPowerBonus)
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = (v_IsRun.Value and baseRunSpeed or baseMoveSpeed) * (1 + speedBonus)
	humanoid.JumpPower = baseJumpPower * (1 + jumpPowerBonus)
end

local function bindHorseBonusChanged(player:Player)
	disconnectBonusConnections()
	if not player then return end
	for _, valueObject in ipairs({PlayerAttributeValue.horseSpeedBonus, PlayerAttributeValue.horseJumpPowerBonus}) do
		local value = ValueHelper:FindValue(player, valueObject)
		if value then
			table.insert(bonusConnections, value.Changed:Connect(updateHorseMovementStats))
		end
	end
end

local function onIsRunChanged()
	updateHorseMovementStats()
end

local function setIsOnHorse(occupant:Humanoid,onHorse:boolean)
	if not occupant then return end
	local character:Model = occupant.Parent
	if onHorse then
		character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Riding)
		
		local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
		if player then
			v_lastRidePlayer.Value = player
			bindHorseBonusChanged(player)
			updateHorseMovementStats()
			DataHelper:AddStats(v_lastRidePlayer.Value,CommonEnum.Stats.RideHorse,1)
		end
	else
		disconnectBonusConnections()
		character:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Riding)
	end
end

						end

while true do
	local dt = wait(1)
	shitCD -= dt
	
	local maxEnergy = v_MaxEnergy.Value
	if GameHelper:IsInCampfire(horse:GetPivot().Position) then
		v_Energy.Value = math.clamp(v_Energy.Value + maxEnergy * 0.1,1,maxEnergy)
	else
		if occupant and v_IsRun.Value then
			local cost = 1
			local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(occupant.Parent)
			if player then
				local v_horseEnergyDerate:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.horseEnergyDerate)
				local derate = v_horseEnergyDerate and math.clamp(v_horseEnergyDerate.Value, 0, 0.8) or 0
				cost -= cost * derate
				if cost < 0 then cost = 0 end
			end
			
			v_Energy.Value = math.clamp(v_Energy.Value - cost,0,maxEnergy)
			if v_Energy.Value <= 0 then
				v_IsRun.Value = false
			end
		end
	end
	
	if shitTimes <= 3 and shitCD <= 0 then
		shitCD = math.random(300,600)

		end)

			DataHelper:AddStats(v_lastRidePlayer.Value,CommonEnum.Stats.HorsePooping,1)
		end
	end
